recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It fills the remaining current-build ModelInfo omission for FHIR-26453 while preserving the later FHIR-36687 element names; do not reintroduce presentationText/concentrationText.
issue_request: FHIR-26453 was Published/Persuasive for BR&R and requested text expressions of Ingredient strength for both presentation and concentration, in addition to structured strength, because some real-world strength statements are complex or legacy-textual.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit 35630a55b9 added the original presentationText and concentrationText fields to the old Ingredient spreadsheet source. Later source refactors moved the active Ingredient definition to source/ingredient/structuredefinition-Ingredient.xml, where the requested capability already exists as Ingredient.substance.strength.textPresentation and textConcentration.
additional_context: FHIR-36687 later renamed presentationText/concentrationText to textPresentation/textConcentration because peer names cannot start with a choice-type prefix beside presentation[x] and concentration[x]. Ingredient and Library are active in source/fhir.ini, MedicinalProductIngredient maps to Ingredient, and Library/FHIR-ModelInfo is listed as an active Library example. Community searches found no direct FHIR-26453 discussion or conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Added textPresentation and textConcentration as FHIR.string elements to MedicinalProductIngredient.Strength in source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml and regenerated the embedded base64 data in source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so both ModelInfo source surfaces stay synchronized. No Ingredient StructureDefinition change was needed.
